name: Retool MCP
description: Builds and inspects Retool apps, queries connected resources, and manages users, permissions, and audit logs from Claude, Cursor, or Codex, for Retool builders and admins.

skills.name: App Building
skills.description: Starts or continues building Retool apps from your coding environment, imports existing React apps, and inspects existing apps.

skills.name: Resource Queries
skills.description: Writes queries against connected Retool resources for data analysis, and lists, creates, and inspects resource configurations.

skills.name: User Administration
skills.description: Bulk-invites users, audits who has access, disables users, and resets two-factor authentication in your Retool organization.

skills.name: Permission Management
skills.description: Creates permission groups and custom roles, and checks or changes who can access an app, resource, or workflow.

skills.name: Audit Log Investigation
skills.description: Investigates Retool audit logs and reviews past and current agent activity, including cancelling a failed app build.
